summary: Backend fully tested via pytest (26/26 passed on public preview URL, 100%). Covered auth (register/login/me/401), catalog (8 categories, product list/filter/search/slug), addresses CRUD, orders (subtotal/discount/free-delivery >=499, delivery fee 29 <499, status timeline), promo (GHAR50 valid/min/invalid), delivery pincode check, subscriptions CRUD, recipes list + by-slug. Frontend smoke tested on mobile viewport 390x844: login screen prefills test@gharana.in/Test@1234, Enter Gharana submits and lands on Home screen. Home renders Namaste greeting, ETA pill (Standard 90 min based on pincode last digit), trust ticker marquee, hero 'Ghar jaisi shuddhata', 8 category chips (flours-atta, oils-ghee, dals-pulses, whole-spices, rice-grains, millets, specialty-flours, healthy-staples), Gharana Specials products, bottom tab bar (Home/Shop/Cart/Account). Category chip tap navigates to /category/flours-atta correctly. No React Native red screen. Deep flows (add-to-cart stepper, product detail tabs, checkout, order tracking, subscriptions/addresses/referrals screens) not exhaustively clicked due to budget — main agent should verify visually if desired. Two RN-web deprecation warnings noted (non-blocking).

issues: React-Native-Web console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Cosmetic only, no crash.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Migrate any inline shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowRadius/shadowOpacity to boxShadow to silence RN-web console warnings.
(Optional/cosmetic) Replace props.pointerEvents with style={{ pointerEvents: ... }} to silence RN-web warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id in projections — good.
JWT_SECRET has an insecure dev default; production must override via env.
Promo/delivery-fee/order-total math validated end-to-end and matches spec (free delivery >=499, GHAR50 flat 50 min 299).

success_rate.frontend: smoke pass — login + home + category nav verified; deeper flows not exhaustively re-clicked
